serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
I wonder how Annalie is doing.
She was pretty shaken up the last time I saw her, but after getting some repair work done I feel like she was a lot better.
I should go and check on her just in case.
There’s always a chance that something bad could happen again. It seems like people are crazy these days…
Also, I’m sure Annalie could still use some additional work force, her shop was trashed pretty hard.
I’m already in front of the shop…
Doors are closed, but I can hear someone inside. Let’s try knocking..
*knock knock*
…
No one is opening.
Maybe no one is there after all.
I will try one more time.
*knock knock*
…
You: It’s me Annalie! I came to help!
